references.name: Market Wizards
New Market Wizards
references.connection:
Features Tom Basso ("Mr. Serenity");
  Eckhardt's chapter alone worth the price

references.name: The Power of Myth
references.connection:
Foundation for the Holy Grail metaphor;
  one of Tharp's all-time favorites

references.name: Smarter Trading
references.connection:
Source of the adaptive moving average and
  efficiency ratio concepts

references.name: Computer Analysis of Futures
references.connection:
One of the best books on systems
  development; random-entry testing

references.name: How to Make Money in Stocks
references.connection:
Source of CANSLIM methodology reviewed
  throughout as pure setup system

references.name: The Warren Buffett Way
references.connection:
Best book on Buffett's strategy, though
  author has normal entry bias

references.name: Reminiscences of a Stock Operator
references.connection:
1920s bucket-shop arbitrage as historical
  edge example

references.name: Street Smarts
references.connection:
Source of Turtle Soup strategy
  (failed-test setup)

references.name: New Concepts in Technical Trading
references.connection:
Classic source for ADX, ATR, RSI, and
  directional movement

references.name: Beyond Technical Analysis
references.connection:
One of first books to go beyond entry
  emphasis; adaptive MA variant

references.name: Portfolio Management Formulas
references.connection:
Difficult but essential reading on optimal
  f and position sizing mathematics

references.name: Winner Take All
references.connection:
Witty treatment of fundamental trading;
  source of one book system

references.name: Campaign Trading
references.connection:
Source of MAE concept; emphasizes the more
  important aspects of trading

references.name: Money Management Strategies
references.connection:
Good on risk control, less focused on
  position sizing per se

references.name: Mindtraps
references.connection:
Psychological biases in all aspects of
  trading and investing

references.name: Commonsense Betting
references.connection:
A must for stretching into position sizing
  from a non-market domain

references.name: Trading with the Odds
references.connection:
Source of the dev-stop; Tharp says there is
  more to this book than even the author knows

references.name: Nothing
references.connection:
A book about flow with nothing to do with
  trading, but Tharp says all traders should
  read it

references.name: Beating the Dow
references.connection:
Source of the Foolish Four / Dogs of the
  Dow dividend strategy
